notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least X power.
easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least one mana.
description:
Activate another land that enters untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and returning the land tapped in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}
Activate Gretchen by paying {G}{U} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, causing you to draw a card and put the land returned to hand in step 2 onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
